globalImageRegression: NOT APPLICABLE: focal SICOF UI/backend/private source cache, unrelated bundle chunks identical, no shared repository/assets/Auth/routing/SW logic changes
limitations: Measured 8.368s workspace and 7.774s XLSX are individual requests, not instant-loading or p95 guarantees.
Every four-minute refresh may observe changes up to the five-minute freshness limit; source failures or expired copies remain explicit.
Manual Google refresh still depends on the upstream read latency. In-flight lease prevents duplicates; failed/manual overlap may require another tick.
Browser wait deadlines do not cancel server execution; there is no automatic retry or polling.
Isolated concurrency tests serialize contenders in PGlite; real exclusion follows PostgreSQL row locks and lease tokens, not a multi-connection production race test.
BEHAVIOR used by Finance remains on its existing direct reader. This task optimizes SICOF workspace/calculation/export.
Freshness is revalidated before returning server data and independently before UI export/save; network transit itself cannot be made instantaneous.
